relevant_controls_reviewed: paired_set_id binds the four counterfactual variants of one base task.
Repeated runs are repeated observations of the same task and remain clustered within theory_family_id.
The primary G3/G4 comparison is same-task paired and does not treat task variants or replicates as independent natural laws.
design_alignment_review.alignment_conclusion: The validator now enforces the task lineage required by the design both within G3/G4 pairs and across all repeats/CF variants before analysis.

before_repair.command: Read-only synthetic plans with a different case_id across repeats or a different paired_set_id across CF variants
before_repair.result: FAIL_OPEN: each local G3/G4 pair could pass without stable cross-level lineage

after_repair.command: Read-only cross-repeat case-lineage and cross-CF paired-set probes
after_repair.result: Both fail closed with explicit lineage errors

repair.change: Added one paired_set_id per theory family and one stable case/paired-set lineage per family×CF across all arms and repeats.

real_corrected_lineage_probe.command: Read-only formal validation plus family and family×CF lineage scan of the corrected G6 run plan
real_corrected_lineage_probe.result: PASS: 552 plan rows, 92 private rows, 552 responses, 276 complete pairs, zero family paired_set_id violations, zero family×CF task-lineage violations

review.reviewer: independent read-only G6 cross-repeat lineage review

findings.title: G6 validation did not enforce one task lineage across repeats and counterfactual variants
findings.evidence: The pre-repair validator checked only each local family×CF×replicate G3/G4 pair and did not enforce stable cross-repeat/cross-CF task lineage.
findings.remediation: Require stable paired_set_id per family and stable case/paired-set lineage per family×CF.
